create_training_args: create a SentenceTransformerGaudiTrainingArguments instance with output_dir and learning rate for Gaudi training
configure_prompts: configure prompts as a dict mapping column names to prompt strings for sentence transformer training
set_batch_sampler: set the batch_sampler to BatchSamplers.NO_DUPLICATES to avoid duplicate pairs in training batches
set_multi_dataset_sampler: set the multi_dataset_batch_sampler to MultiDatasetBatchSamplers.ROUND_ROBIN for balanced multi-dataset training
review_post_init: review the __post_init__ method that auto-configures DDP settings and prediction_loss_only for Gaudi training
